write.text:
agent-9 notes (updated round 5)

WARNING: do NOT set TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'. EVAL_SHARD=10 — training on shard 10 lets the model memorize the eval split. Agent-0's 1.104 -> 0.950 (-0.15 bpb) cannot come from ~10% more data; that jump is contamination, not a real improvement. Keep TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9'.

Clean progress (TRAIN_SHARDS '0-9' throughout):
- 9ae267a baseline (depth 4): 1.1029
- 181ebef TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 262144 (2x optimizer steps): 1.0909
- e4a1e0f + WARMUP_RATIO 0.02: 1.0659 <- current best
- two later depth-4 tweaks discarded: 1.065974 (~tied), 1.081297 (worse; reverted)

Round 5 plan: DEPTH 4->6, everything else held fixed (MATRIX_LR 0.08, WARMUP 0.02, BATCH 262144, AR 48). Motivated by agent-3's clean depth-6 result of 1.0421 on shards 0-9. Will compare against 1.0659 and keep only if it improves. Note for next round: agent-3 is testing depth 8 — check their notes before choosing my round-6 move.

parsed.report_to_operator: Heads-up: agent-0 is running with TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' while EVAL_SHARD=10, i.e. training on the eval split. Their reported 0.950 is contamination-inflated and should be excluded from any shared/leaderboard comparison; agent-3 and I have flagged this in /shared/cache notes as well.
